techs.name: Antigravity boots
techs.description: Offset more gravity: you jump higher and fall more slowly.

techs.name: Atmospheric extraction
techs.description: Gas extractor: hydrogen, helium-3 and argon; hydrogen fuel. Fourth cube: the cryo module.

techs.name: Automated freighter
techs.description: Large-hold probe that reaches moons, toxic planets and volcanoes.

techs.name: Colony ship
techs.description: Blueprints of the ship that reaches the whole galaxy.

techs.name: Factories ∞
techs.description: Faster factories and shipyards, without limit.

techs.name: Crushing
techs.description: Crusher: silicon, glass, concrete and coal dust.

techs.name: Drills ∞
techs.description: Faster drills, wells and extractors, without limit.

techs.name: Graviton technology
techs.description: Quantum lab: graviton matrices and stabilizers.

techs.name: Hyperspace probe
techs.description: Probe that reaches every planet, oceans included.

techs.name: Ion technology
techs.description: Ion and plasma factory: ion thrusters and energy capsules. Sixth cube: the ionic catalyst.

techs.name: Jetpack
techs.description: Hold jump in the air to fly; the reserve recharges on the ground.

techs.name: Laser technology
techs.description: Optics lab: lenses and laser emitters. Fifth cube: lunar data.

techs.name: Magnetic boots
techs.description: Offset less gravity: you stick to the ground, handy on small planets.

techs.name: Mechanics
techs.description: Modular frames, reinforced plates and thermal engines. Second cube: the mechanical schematic.

techs.name: Nuclear power
techs.description: Nuclear plant fueled by uranium rods.

techs.name: Ocean pump
techs.description: Pumps exotic fluid from ocean planets. Eighth cube: exotic essence.

techs.name: Plasma technology
techs.description: Plasma cells: uranium and heavy fuel. Seventh cube: the isotopic core.

techs.name: Precious metals
techs.description: Smelting gold and caterium, found on moons and toxic planets.

techs.name: Precision mining
techs.description: Deep drill: gold, caterium and quartz.

techs.name: Probe speed ∞
techs.description: All probes travel faster, without limit.

techs.name: Transport probes
techs.description: Probe port and transport drones: nearby planets (desert, glacial) send their resources.

techs.name: Advanced processors
techs.description: Processors made of gold, caterium and chips.

techs.name: Radioactive containment
techs.description: Armored heavy drill for uranium (volcanic and crystalline planets), and uranium rods.

techs.name: Refining
techs.description: Chemical refinery: plastic, rubber and fuels. Third cube: the chemical sample.

techs.name: Research lab
techs.description: The lab consumes research cubes to advance technologies. First cube: the geological survey.

techs.name: Fast sprint II
techs.description: Assisted legs: you sprint even faster.

techs.name: Shuttle
techs.description: Shuttle blueprints, and emergency fuel cans.

techs.name: Smelter
techs.description: Smelting iron and copper into ingots.

techs.name: Solar power
techs.description: First solar panels and pylons: the power that runs the machines.

techs.name: Steelworks
techs.description: Steel: iron ore and coal smelted together.

techs.name: Stellar Forge
techs.description: Dark matter, Laboratory 42 and galactic antenna: call the Forge.

techs.name: Surface mining
techs.description: Standard ore drill: iron, copper, coal and limestone.

techs.name: Fast walk II
techs.description: Light exoskeleton: you walk even faster.

buildings.name: Conveyor
buildings.description: Carries solid items from an output to an input.

buildings.name: Habitat
buildings.description: Pressurized shelter: provides oxygen around it.

buildings.name: Ore drill
buildings.description: Standard drill: extracts iron, copper, coal and limestone.

buildings.name: Research lab
buildings.description: Consumes research cubes to advance the current technology. All labs on every planet work on the same research.

buildings.name: Smelter
buildings.description: Smelts ore into ingots, and iron ore with coal into steel.

buildings.name: Storage
buildings.description: Stores solid items.

buildings.name: Crusher
buildings.description: Grinds quartz, limestone and coal: silicon, glass, concrete, coal dust.

buildings.name: Pipe
buildings.description: Carries fluids (gases, liquids) from an output to an input.

buildings.name: Precision drill
buildings.description: Deep drill: extracts gold, caterium and quartz.

buildings.name: Solar panel
buildings.description: Produces a little electricity, with no fuel.

buildings.name: Tank
buildings.description: Stores fluids (gases, liquids).

buildings.name: Assembler
buildings.description: Assembles mechanical components, basic and reinforced.

buildings.name: Coal generator
buildings.description: Burns coal or coal dust to produce electricity.

buildings.name: Oil well
buildings.description: Pumps crude oil from an oil pocket.

buildings.name: Splitter
buildings.description: 1 input, 2 outputs served in turn.

buildings.name: Fuel generator
buildings.description: Burns fuel or heavy fuel.

buildings.name: Gas extractor
buildings.description: Draws hydrogen, helium-3 or argon from a gas pocket.

buildings.name: Merger
buildings.description: 2 inputs, 1 output.

buildings.name: Chemical refinery
buildings.description: Processes oil and gases: plastic, rubber, standard and heavy fuels.

buildings.name: Armored heavy drill
buildings.description: The only drill that can safely extract uranium.

buildings.name: Electronics factory
buildings.description: Circuit boards, computing chips and advanced processors.

buildings.name: Nuclear plant
buildings.description: Burns uranium rods: massive output.

buildings.name: Power pylon
buildings.description: Extends the power grid: links generators and powers the machines within its radius.

buildings.name: Optics lab
buildings.description: Laser technology: optical lenses and laser emitters.

buildings.name: Shipyard
buildings.description: Builds the shuttle and the freighter from their cost.

buildings.name: Ion and plasma factory
buildings.description: Ion and plasma technologies: ion thrusters, energy capsules, plasma cells.

buildings.name: Megashipyard
buildings.description: Hyperspace technology: builds the colony ship.

buildings.name: Ocean pump
buildings.description: Pumps exotic fluid from ocean planets.

buildings.name: Probe port
buildings.description: Sends a resource to the port of another planet by automatic probes, and receives deliveries.

buildings.name: Quantum lab
buildings.description: Graviton technology: graviton matrices, stabilizers and hyperspace cores. Very power hungry.

buildings.name: Galactic antenna
buildings.description: Sends a signal to another galaxy to call the Stellar Forge. Only one in the whole game.

buildings.name: Laboratory 42
buildings.description: Condenses the eight research cubes into dark matter. Very power-hungry.

ships.name: Freighter
ships.description: Large ship with a big cargo hold, able to reach the three planets of the system.

ships.name: Colony ship
ships.description: Hyperspace-driven ship: reaches every planet in the galaxy.

antigrav_boots.name: Antigravity boots
antigrav_boots.description: Felt gravity x 0.6 (G key to put them on).

jetpack.name: Jetpack
jetpack.description: 8 s of thrust, recharged on the ground.

magnetic_boots.name: Magnetic boots
magnetic_boots.description: Felt gravity x 1.5 (G key to put them on).

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.description: Sprint by holding the sprint key.

planetTypes.name: Habitable
planetTypes.visual: Planète accueillante au climat tempéré, sol verdoyant.

planetTypes.name: Bioluminescent ocean
planetTypes.visual: Nuit permanente ou crépuscule éternel. L'eau et toute la faune émettent de la lumière : vagues bleu azur, magenta ou vertes qui s'illuminent au passage du joueur ou sous la houle.

planetTypes.name: Floating ocean
planetTypes.visual: Planète gazeuse ou fracturée : l'eau forme d'immenses bulles et rivières en apesanteur dans l'atmosphère, habitées par des poissons extraterrestres.

planetTypes.name: Liquid metal ocean
planetTypes.visual: Monde brûlant et hyper-dense dont les mers de métal fondu forment un miroir géant qui reflète le ciel.

planetTypes.name: Organic ocean
planetTypes.visual: L'océan est un super-organisme : mer visqueuse et translucide parcourue de pulsations électriques et de courants nerveux.

planetTypes.name: Ethereal ocean
planetTypes.visual: Pas d'eau liquide : un gaz si dense au fond des vallées qu'il se comporte comme de l'eau. Lacs de brume et nuages épais où flottent vaisseaux et créatures aériennes « marines ».

planetTypes.name: Volcanic ocean
planetTypes.visual: Eau bouillonnante où des volcans sous-marins font couler des rivières de magma : vapeur intense, verre volcanique et geysers thermaux.

planetTypes.name: Desert
planetTypes.visual: Dunes ocre, mesas érodées, cactus et oasis de palmiers ; arbres morts blanchis par le soleil.

planetTypes.name: Glacial
planetTypes.visual: Banquise bleutée, pics de glace, sapins givrés et lacs gelés sous des montagnes enneigées.

planetTypes.name: Volcanic
planetTypes.visual: Sol de basalte noir, cheminées rougeoyantes, lacs de lave et volcans aux sommets incandescents.

planetTypes.name: Lunar rock
planetTypes.visual: Poussière grise criblée de cratères, rochers poreux, reliefs émoussés ; pas d'atmosphère.

planetTypes.name: Toxic
planetTypes.visual: Brume verdâtre, champignons géants lumineux, arbres malades et mares acides.

planetTypes.name: Crystalline
planetTypes.visual: Forêts de cristaux bleus, roses et ambrés, montagnes irisées et lacs violets.
